# Optional Codex companion

Omarchy Watch now keeps Codex integration separate from the base desktop
installation. Codex activity and completion alerts remain available through
the optional [Omarchy Watch for Codex](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch-codex)
companion plugin.

## Changes

- stop installing or modifying Codex lifecycle hooks during Watch setup
- let users install and remove Codex support independently of Omarchy Watch
- explain the companion's four lifecycle hooks and require explicit opt-in
- keep lifecycle events limited to state, opaque identifiers, and timestamps;
  prompts, responses, transcripts, models, and working directories are not sent

Existing v0.5.2 Codex hooks are left untouched during an update, so existing
alerts continue working. Do not install the companion plugin alongside those
legacy hooks; remove the legacy Omarchy Watch hook entries first if you want to
move to the independently managed companion.

Firmware behavior is unchanged from v0.5.2. The attached v0.5.3 flash bundle
remains safe to install without erasing pairing or watch settings.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#install)
for complete setup instructions.

This is an independent community project for development hardware, not an
official Omarchy product or a waterproof consumer watch.
